title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The response must clearly state that a positive charge cannot be suspended stably at the center of the cube.

title: Potential Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The explanation must include the reasoning related to the potential being a saddle point and the implications of Laplace's equation.

title: Electric Field Analysis
description: Optional Criteria: A discussion of the electric field behavior in the vicinity of the center enhances the response.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The response should mention that extrema of potential occur at boundaries or near charges.

title: Saddle Point Clarification
description: Important Criteria: The identification of the center as a saddle point should be clearly articulated.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failing to recognize that the center is not a local minimum is a common mistake.

title: Quantum Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: Mentioning quantum tunneling is not necessary for the classical analysis but could be noted.
